605:t_014:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come back, $$バナージ$$. You're neither a hallucination nor a being of consciousness alone.」

605:t_014:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You still have a place to return to.」

605:t_014:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Think you can hold $$ミネバ$$ like that!? I'll take $$オードリー$$ from you, $$バナージ$$!!」

605:t_014:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This is the place you must return to.」

605:t_014:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come see you... You...」

605:t_014:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's right. You must come back.」

605:t_015:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The GN particles... are filling this region of space.」

605:t_015:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「With this, our hearts and $$バナージ$$ will be connected.」

605:t_015:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come back, $$バナージ$$. You're neither a hallucination nor a being of consciousness alone.」

605:t_015:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You still have a place to return to.」

605:t_015:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Think you can hold $$ミネバ$$ like that!? I'll take $$オードリー$$ from you, $$バナージ$$!!」

605:t_015:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This is the place you must return to.」

605:t_015:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come see you... You...」

605:t_016:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, that settles things for now.」

605:t_016:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's happening with $$アムブリエル$$?」

605:t_016:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let's take our time thinking about what to do with her from now on.」

605:t_016:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Confirm the surrounding situation. If there are no enemy readings, issue return orders to all units...」

605:t_016:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Wait, please! $$ヴェーダ$$ hasn't shut down its system yet!」

605:t_016:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「This time, something is being transmitted from $$ヴェーダ$$ to the whole world!」

605:t_016:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The truth at the bottom of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

605:t_016:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$クロノ$$'s doctrine... So the time has come for it to be revealed...」

605:t_016:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「It is not I who will speak of it.」

605:t_016:14.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The footage is coming up!」

605:t_016:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
「This is... $$エルガン・ローディック$$!」

605:t_017:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not permitting humanity's evolution... That is the very doctrine of $$クロノ$$...!」

605:t_017:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Our history... the history of all the parallel worlds was created by the $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_017:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's been hundreds of years since humans first went to the Moon!」

605:t_017:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Humanity has been watched ever since then... By $$クロノ$$... By the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

605:t_017:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So this is what $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ meant when it talked about the Moon!」

605:t_017:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even the assassination of $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ was orchestrated by the $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_017:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you saying the $$ザビ家$$ were just made to dance, too...?」

605:t_017:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「The war between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s... All of it was caused by $$クロノ$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_017:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So the three great nations and $$ＯＺ$$ were the same...」

605:t_017:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「They were doing things like that...! Just how much power do the $$サイデリアル$$ have!?」

605:t_017:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「Fundamental calamity... You can feel it just by looking at those black $$アンゲロイ$$ and the crystal monsters...」

605:t_017:12.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Can we win...? Against guys like that...」

605:t_017:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So this despair is exactly what $$フル・フロンタル$$ meant by closing off possibilities...」

605:t_017:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「I understand now... If the human species continues, we will surely end up fighting the $$サイデリアル$$... the fundamental calamity...」

605:t_017:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「That very fact is the future of despair...!」

605:t_017:16.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ tried to guide the emergence of $$イノベイター$$s as the beings who would surpass it...」

605:t_017:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And $$エルガン・ローディック$$ formed $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ as the ones who would fight it.」

605:t_017:18.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... Did you know about them... about the $$ＡＤＷ$$, even before the $$大時空震動$$?」

605:t_017:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Through the visit of that $$エルガン・ローディック$$, I learned of the existence of the parallel worlds and the future of despair...」

605:t_017:20.en:
$$サイアム$$
「And right after the $$ラプラス事件$$, I saw someone smiling sadly in the light of the explosion... That convinced me that humanity has an Administrator.」

605:t_017:21.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I am the same as $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... I waited for someone strong enough to break out of that prison to appear...」

605:t_017:22.en:
$$サイアム$$
「And that wish has been granted...」

605:t_017:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean we... $c... are that power...?」

605:t_017:24.en:
???
「It is you yourselves who will choose that.」

605:t_018:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$... So you're here too.」

605:t_018:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$リディ・マーセナス$$ learned this fact and once sank into the depths of despair.」

605:t_018:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's true... When I was adrift in space, that man rescued me and told me about the Administrator's existence.」

605:t_018:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「So what do you want with us?」

605:t_018:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are you telling us to help purge $$クロノ$$, the $$サイデリアル$$' lapdogs, as the Reformists?」

605:t_018:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Or did you come to see how shocked we are?」

605:t_018:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on you as well.」

605:t_018:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Before that, let us welcome them.」

605:t_019:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「They seem quite displeased that we learned $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

605:t_019:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Don't get conceited, Earthling.」

605:t_019:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「The head of the $$サイデリアル$$ has come in person!」

605:t_019:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Welcome, Emperor $$アウストラリス$$. Now all twelve $$スフィア$$s are gathered in this place.」

605:t_019:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... He is the Reactor of the $$立ち上がる射手$$.」

kept_omissions: 605:t_016:2/605:t_016:4: 彼女 = Ambriel is settled by context (she), kept as 'she'/'her'.
605:t_017:9 etc.: subjects restored; none knowingly kept dropped.
uncertain: 605:t_018:7: 改革派として - rendered 'as the Reformists' (ambiguous whether Crowe means ZEXIS joining the Reformists or acting on their behalf).
605:t_017:18: 彼等の…ＡＤＷの = 'about them... about the $$ＡＤＷ$$'; referent of 彼等 (Sidereal/Administrators) assumed to be the same group as ADW.
605:t_017:13: 可能性を閉ざす rendered 'closing off possibilities' (plural, following the earlier Frontal phrasing in spirit; not checked against the finished Frontal lines).
605:t_019:5 and 605:t_019:3-4: 皇帝アウストラリス written 'Emperor $$アウストラリス$$' (token + plain title) rather than the proposed compound token.
605:t_017:20: 寂しげに微笑む者 = 'someone smiling sadly' (gender/identity unknown, kept neutral); 人類の管理者 = 'humanity has an Administrator' (Administrator capitalised as in dlg_2086_02).
605:t_017:4: 月 = the Moon; Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ． as being token #pilot, pronoun 'it'.
605:t_015 rows 0-9 are an exact repeat of t_014:2-9 (same Japanese); translated identically.
